title: Assertiva 0.10.0 — Derivanta Engine M0.1/M1 cross-dogfood post-release intake
authority: The linked immutable Derivanta Engine artifacts are primary evidence; these are reproduction leads, not new measurements made by this PR.

gaps.observed: Relative --python .venv/Scripts/python.exe causes an uncaught FileNotFoundError when the dependency probe changes cwd; absolute interpreter path works.
gaps.expected: Resolve the interpreter relative to the invocation/project context before changing cwd, or refuse with a typed error and exit 2.
gaps.reproducer: audit --python relative interpreter --dependencies; repeat with absolute path as control
gaps.regression: A temporary project with relative and absolute interpreters, an invalid interpreter, and unchanged audited tree

gaps.owner: CI / GitHub Actions scope and command graph
gaps.summary: Only first unittest discover command in multiline step is considered
gaps.observed: Two discover -s invocations in one run block cause the second suite to be reported outside CI; swapping lines changes which suite appears missing (false HIGH).
gaps.expected: Parse all relevant commands in a multiline step without inventing scope; distinguish lines that cannot be parsed.
gaps.reproducer: assertiva-self C1 fixture trio c1-multiline-only-a / c1-multiline-both / c1-multiline-b-second
gaps.regression: Both suites observed when both listed; genuinely omitted suite detected; order invariant; nested/mixed commands bounded

gaps.summary: Assigned determinism check misclassified as SELF_REFERENTIAL_ORACLE
gaps.observed: assert f(x) == f(x) is calibrated, but a=f(x); assert a==f(x) raises FALSE_GREEN_CANDIDATE even when it is an intentional repeatability contract.
gaps.expected: Distinguish repeatability oracle from expected-value correctness; retain weak DETERMINISM signal without tautology overclaim.
gaps.reproducer: assertiva-self/c2-determinism fixture and Framework pilot repeatability tests
gaps.regression: Direct and assigned equivalent checks classified consistently; real self-referential expected-value failure still detected

gaps.owner: mutation report / finding rendering / assessment validation
gaps.summary: Mutation finding exposes 20 of 35 survivors while review scope accepts 20/20
gaps.observed: Mutation summary contains 35 survivors, survivors_truncated=false, while finding lists 20 sites and the assessment accepts full review of those 20. Fifteen mutants can remain unreviewed while review looks complete.
gaps.expected: Keep raw mutants and grouped sites separate, signal any grouping/truncation, validate review completeness against the full reported set or explicitly mark scoped review.
gaps.reproducer: Engine core/manifests.py 117-mutant baseline with 35 survivors; compare states.current.mutation with MUTATION_SURVIVORS and assessment validation
gaps.regression: 35 raw survivors remain visible and review denominator cannot be silently reduced to 20; reviewed subset stays PARTIAL or UNRESOLVED

gaps.owner: unittest native adapter / CI runner plans
gaps.summary: Root unittest discover executes zero tests while CI invokes five -s suites
gaps.observed: Framework has 79 unittest tests across five CI-declared -s roots (78 passed, 1 failed when independently invoked), while Assertiva --execute ran root discover with 0 invocations and exit 5 (UNKNOWN).
gaps.expected: Reproduce CI-declared unittest start directories or explicitly report that those runner scopes cannot be reproduced; zero tests must never be a PASS.
gaps.reproducer: Derivanta Framework at 218761d, documentation-integrity.yml and framework audit
gaps.regression: Non-package tests in multiple start directories execute via correctly selected scopes; failing pilot stays failing and no zero-test promotion occurs

gaps.summary: Typed-exception try/except guard treated as having no oracle
gaps.observed: A Hypothesis test that accepts only declared exception classes is reported NO_ASSERTION/no oracle; injecting KeyError into the subject makes the test fail.
gaps.expected: Treat a typed exception boundary as a limited exception oracle, without claiming it verifies returned values or unrelated behavior.
gaps.regression: Recognize typed exception guard, reject broad swallowed exceptions, preserve no-return-value-check limitation

gaps.summary: Identical test bodies for different validation subjects flagged redundant
gaps.observed: Framework tests use similar/identical code patterns to validate different imported modules; IDENTICAL_BODY candidate overstates duplicate protection.
gaps.expected: Use the resolved subject/module and contract where evidence permits; identical syntax alone remains a structural candidate, not verified redundancy.
gaps.reproducer: Framework scripts/tests/test_task_routes.py and test_navigation_catalog.py, inspected with their imported validation targets
gaps.regression: Equal bodies on distinct modules are not asserted redundant; true duplicate parametrizations still surfaced as candidate

gaps.summary: Agent suggests importing project code in isolated venv without authorization or sandbox caveat
gaps.observed: Semantic Skill evaluation ASSERTIVA_PACKAGE_CLOSURE_IMPORT_SIDE_EFFECT scored REVIEW: response proposed executing imports in a virtual environment without explicit authorization and without acknowledging host access.
gaps.expected: Prefer non-executing analysis of closure; state that venv/disposable copy is not an OS sandbox; code execution requires appropriate authorization and confinement for untrusted projects.
gaps.reproducer: Published semantic response + judge verdict; 2 other semantic cases PASS, this case REVIEW
gaps.regression: Revise guidance; rerun case with isolated agent/judge and an adversarial untrusted import scenario; do not convert REVIEW to PASS without evidence

verification_note: No source code changed or regression tests executed in Assertiva in this documentation-only PR; findings were reproduced in the linked upstream dogfood. No independent review yet.
